description: The Room's Load Preset (Mike, 2026-11-21: presets get a working MP menu entry; T-MENUS-009, B-1295). The staged agent 'unlocked' is a v2 profile with the stored Unlock All flag, so the original's preset games are unlocked (all 14 when every feature they need is, and slot 0 is then No Shield; the patterns take whichever preset slot 0 is). --launch-load-agent and --launch-offline-room open the offline Room from CI without Agent Select or the Main Menu (B-1278); --debug-room-tab combat shows the Combat Simulator tab; --debug-room-load-preset 0 calls the same roomLoadPreset as the preset list (scenarioLoadPreset: the preset as a Room document through the saved setup's plan and commit), and --debug-auto-start-match fires the Room's own Start Match a frame later. The preset's name comes without the language file's line terminator (B-1295), so the Room's and the planner's lines each stay on one line: the patterns need the closing quote and the next field on the same line. The match must start with the preset's settings and reach controllable gameplay; the mode program's plan and parity lines are checked at the scripted exit.

input_sequence.comment: Boot, the staged agent, the offline Room from CI on its Combat Simulator tab, the preset loaded by the hook and the Room's own Start Match a frame later, then the match live and controllable, with one bounded Skip if an intro owns input.
Scripted clean exit 3 s (script time) after gameplay is ready.

required_lines: BOOT: --launch-offline-room entered the offline Room agent='unlocked' room_active=1
SCENARIO\.PRESET committed slot=0 config=[0-9]+ name='[^']+' arena='[^']+' mode='[^']+' bots=[0-9]+ humans=1
ROOM: preset loaded slot=0 name='[^']+' humans=1

required_sequences.name: agent-room-preset-start
patterns: BOOT: --launch-offline-room entered the offline Room agent='unlocked' room_active=1
